proposal.description: meta_ff is pre-loaded with the live async_in during reset instead of the safe RESET_VALUE, as if reset should 'prime' the synchroniser with the real input
proposal.reason: If async_in is not RESET_VALUE when rst_n goes high, sync_out moves to async_in on the first clock after release instead of the second. It also no longer holds the worst-case value for the full two clocks.

proposal.description: sync_out follows the live async_in during reset instead of holding the safe RESET_VALUE
proposal.reason: While rst_n is low and async_in differs from RESET_VALUE, sync_out shows the unsynchronised input instead of the safe level. For a fault input, this means it reports no fault during reset.

proposal.description: The second stage becomes a two-sample agreement filter: sync_out takes meta_ff only when it equals the current async_in, otherwise it holds
proposal.reason: A pulse on async_in that lasts a single clock never reaches sync_out, while the original passes it through two clocks later. Input that toggles every clock leaves sync_out stuck at its old value.
